summary: This note is a URDF/XML robot description for a TurtleBot3 Burger model built for the Webots simulator with ROS 2 integration. It configures a LDS-01 lidar publishing to /scan at 5 Hz, an IMU plugin publishing to /imu at 20 Hz with inertial unit, gyro and accelerometer devices, and a ros2_control system with two wheel motor joints using velocity command interfaces. It also references a placeholder example plugin class in the webots_ros2_turtlebot package.
one_line: URDF/XML description of a TurtleBot3 Burger robot for Webots with ROS 2 lidar, IMU and wheel control configuration.
key_facts: The robot is named "TurtleBot3 Burger Webots" in the URDF robot tag.
The LDS-01 lidar device is enabled with an updateRate of 5 and publishes to the topic /scan.
The LDS-01 lidar uses the frame name LDS-01 and has alwaysOn set to false.
The IMU plugin type is webots_ros2_driver::Ros2IMU with an updateRate of 20.
The IMU plugin publishes to the topic /imu with frame name imu_link.
The IMU plugin uses devices named inertial_unit, gyro and accelerometer.
A plugin of type webots_ros2_control::Ros2Control is included in the webots section.
The example plugin comment specifies the format type="package_name.file_name.class_name".
The example plugin is webots_ros2_turtlebot.plugin_example.PluginExample with a parameterExample set to someValue.
The ros2_control block is named WebotsControl and has type system.
The right wheel motor joint exposes a position state interface and a velocity command interface.
The left wheel motor joint exposes a position state interface and a velocity command interface.
